items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: Albert Baptiste, he led the Silverleaf Band when I first started for a while.

ctx.x: I was going to ask some more about the Silverleaf Band. What kind of music they played? Did they play ragtime or was it more blues? Did they use sheet music all the time?

They used sheet music. Yeah, well I'll tell you. See, Albert Baptiste, he led the Silverleaf Band when I first started for a while. And then he was a coffee potter. He worked for O'Keeffe on Magazine Street. That case. Yeah. And it kind of helped with his job. So then he turned over to Oscar Randall. I guess you remember him.
